name: The Ultimate Fighter 9: United States vs. United Kingdom

_provenance.note: Drafted from the source article by scripts/tuf/import_season.mjs, which reads the bracket templates and the episode summaries separately and joins them. Where the two disagree the bout carries no winner and the disagreement is recorded in _conflicts. Finale results are not asserted here; they are verified against our own result rows in seasons.json.

_conflicts.detail: The source's quarter-finals for this division do not close as a self-contained round: 1 fighter(s) appear more than once in this round. That is what a wildcard, second chance or replacement entry looks like, and also what a missing bout looks like; the bracket alone does not say which. The stated bouts are recorded as given and the round is left unverified rather than reordered into something the source does not say.
1 bout(s) appear in the episode summaries but in no bracket: Mark Miller def. Kevin Knabjian, his teammate from home,. Left unplaced rather than assigned to a division by guesswork.

format_exceptions.detail: In post-fight interviews, Lester revealed that, as a kid, his four front, top teeth were knocked out and replaced with false teeth. After the match, in the dressing room area, it was shown that Lester coughed up another tooth.
Jason Pierce reported that he had a staph infection in his already injured foot and ankle. He wasn't sure if he could or would fight in his first round match.

Dan Henderson informed Team U.S. that Jason Pierce would not be fighting in the next match. Dana White called in Frank Lester and Mark Miller and asked them if they would be willing to replace Pierce. Both were willing to do so.
